solution:
The correct answer is __A-S, B-R, C-Q, D-P__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Threading tool__ is matched with S.
 
• __Profile tool__ is matched with R.
 
• __Facing tool__ is matched with Q.
 
• __Knurling tool__ is matched with P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Threading Tool:**

 
 
• Used to cut threads in materials for screws or bolts.
 
• Examples include taps and dies.
 
 
 
• **Profile Tool:**
 
 
• Designed for shaping the outer profile of materials.
 
• Commonly used in lathes for creating complex shapes.
 
 
 
• **Facing Tool:**
 
 
• Used to produce a flat surface on the face of the workpiece.
 
• Essential for lathe operations.
 
 
 
• **Knurling Tool:**
 
 
• Used to create patterns on surfaces for better grip.
 
• Commonly seen on tool handles.
